rules.base: same locked M1-B2 state machine: breadth>=50%, max 2 positions
rules.loss2_cd3: after 2 consecutive losing exits, reject new admissions for 3 market sessions from the latest losing exit
rules.symbol_loss_cd5: after a losing exit in a symbol, reject that symbol for 5 market sessions
rules.breadth_drop10pp_5d: reject new admission if current breadth is at least 10 percentage points below breadth 5 market sessions earlier

validation.note: Baseline should reproduce the previously validated M1-B2 full state-machine result.

limitations: Current 53-symbol universe is projected backward, so survivorship/post-selection bias remains.
Cooldown thresholds were fixed before this run; no search over cooldown lengths or breadth-slope thresholds is performed here.
Each shard uses the existing 140-day portfolio-state pre-roll and 420-day indicator warmup.
Max consecutive losses counts trades ordered by exit timestamp; simultaneous exits are tie-broken by symbol.
